observations: Photo 0: Orange drilling rig mast mounted on back of a white flat-nosed truck cab, parked on bare earth lot among other heavy equipment (wheel loader, forklift).
Photo 1: Side/rear view of same rig showing hydraulic hoses, drill rods, and compressor/engine housing in orange paint, truck cab visible with 'NISSAN DIESEL' type cab shape.

Photo 2: Front view of truck cab, grille badge reads 'UD' and sticker text reads 'Best Pass Steering', 'No Hard Signal' type warning stickers, visible number plate (digits not fully legible), heavy surface rust and dust on hood and cab.
No photo shows engine running, drill rig in operation, hydraulic fluid levels, tyres close-up, or any gauges/instrument panel.
Overall condition shows corrosion, faded paint, and dirt consistent with long outdoor storage or prior heavy use.

claims.evidence: No video or photo shows engine running, drill rotating, or compressor operating; only static exterior shots provided.

claims.claim: Buy to site condition for very serious buyers

risks.risk: Truck chassis mechanical condition unknown (engine, gearbox, brakes) despite heavy rust visible
risks.proof: Video of truck engine starting and driving a short distance

risks.risk: Ownership/registration documents not shown; plate number partially unreadable
risks.proof: Clear photo of vehicle particulars/registration papers matching plate number
risks.if_unproven: priced with legal-risk discount, treated as unverifiable title

Video of truck engine starting and being driven

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig on a Nissan Diesel (UD) chassis, but no photo or clip proves it is operational, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working rig/truck matching the single comparable listing of the same unit.
